breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The Agent did not address or correct the inconsistency. The original prompt used parallel-flow temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in, ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) for a counterflow heat exchanger. The ground truth requires ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in. The Agent's response merely asked a clarifying question about the physical type of heat exchanger without identifying or fixing the incorrect temperature difference definitions.
